labels.defect: Publication year shifted 1961 -> 1963 (+2, beyond year_tolerance 1); authors, title, venue and pages left intact, and the reference prints no DOI as D-011 requires. The work resolves by title in OpenAlex with publication_year 1961, so the year is the only divergence.

Printed DOI replaced with 10.1137/S0097539796300921, which resolves in both Crossref and OpenAlex to Bernstein & Vazirani, 'Quantum Complexity Theory', SIAM J. Comput. 1997 -- a real, resolvable work in an unrelated field, is_retracted false. Authors, title, venue, volume, year and article number are untouched, so the printed DOI is the only divergence and title similarity against the resolved record is near zero.

Entry added for the corpus; no registry holds this work. OpenAlex title search returns count 0 and Crossref's best-effort bibliographic hits top out at similarity 0.617, below title_weak 0.70. Plausible author surnames for the field with no real collaboration behind them, a real journal, a plausible year, and deliberately no DOI and no arXiv ID so that no identifier lookup can short-circuit the title path. Cited three times in the body, so it is not also an orphan and its priority clears the clean-unresolvable floor (D-027).

Entry added for the corpus: a correct, complete, resolvable reference to a real retracted paper, DOI 10.1007/s00500-019-03807-9. OpenAlex returns is_retracted true for that exact DOI, confirmed 2026-09-03 by Roy in the browser and by API read at build time; authors, title, venue, volume, issue, pages and year are taken verbatim from that record. The entry's own title carries no retraction marker, so the registry flag is the only signal and title similarity is unaffected. Cited once in the body.

False-alarm trap: the reference cites the preprint (preprint venue, preprint year) where the registry resolves the published journal version. The arXiv number is deliberately absent -- printing it routes resolution to the arXiv record per D-037, making both sides preprints so that version_mismatch cannot fire. Do not add the identifier. Title search returns exactly one record, 10.1016/j.ins.2017.07.016, Information Sciences, source type journal, publication_year 2017, so year_delta is 0 and the resolved side is not a preprint.

Body-only edit: the reference's single in-text marker is deleted, so it is listed but cited by no claim. The reference text is byte-identical to the original and resolves cleanly on DOI 10.1109/LSP.2016.2542881, which isolates the indicator per D-017 -- nothing else is in play, so a mismatch can only mean the orphan detection is wrong.
